rationale: The candidate reads as a single coherent mass in all four views, with a legible bent-bar/sloped datum and a reasonably clean silhouette. However, the visible court/void is weak and does not convincingly produce an active public ground edge at the verified access frontage; the mass appears semantically closer to a generic stepped/tilted residential block than to a neighborhood-living building with a strong public threshold. The section logic is also too shallow for the program: the roof and massing do not clearly express a usable terrace/court sequence or a calm upper mass over an active ground condition. So while the form is coherent and repairable, it does not hard-pass program fit.
